name: Scheme
definition: Information regarding an enumerated code list and its owner.

NameShort.name: Name Short
NameShort.definition: Short textual description of the scheme.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Code that represents the enumerated list, for example, ISO 6166 for ISIN.

NameLong.name: Name Long
NameLong.definition: Long textual description of the scheme.

DomainValueCode.name: Domain Value Code
DomainValueCode.definition: Code for a specific instance of an entry within the enumerated list, for example, ISIN.

DomainValueName.name: Domain Value Name
DomainValueName.definition: Textual description of the DomainValueCode, for example, International Securities Identification Number.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification information for which a scheme is specified.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.definition: Rating for which an identification by scheme is specified.

CreditorRole.name: Creditor Role
CreditorRole.definition: Creditor for which an identification by scheme is specified.

InformationPartyRole.name: Information Party Role
InformationPartyRole.definition: Role played by a party as source of a scheme code.

AssessmentValidityPeriod.name: Assessment Validity Period
AssessmentValidityPeriod.definition: Period during which the version of the scheme applies (see ISO-8601).

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Specifies the sector to which the scheme applies.

AssetClassification.name: Asset Classification
AssetClassification.definition: Asset for which a classification by scheme is specified.
